paths.title: Full Stack Software Development Engineer (Web / SaaS)
paths.summary: Focuses on architecting scalable modern web applications from responsive frontends to distributed backends, RESTful microservices, relational databases, and cloud deployments.
paths.fit_reasoning: Strong foundational proficiency in Python, JavaScript, and database concepts matches the requirements of Indian product startups and mid-size SaaS firms.

india_market_notes.demand_outlook: Consistently highest fresher hiring volume across Indian tech hubs with heavy emphasis on DSA and hands-on full-stack projects.

yearly_milestones.label: Year 3 (Pre-final Year)
goals: Master intermediate Data Structures & Algorithms
Build full-stack CRUD applications with authentication and relational database models
Prepare for 7th-semester campus placement drives
target_activities: Participate in Smart India Hackathon or college hackathons
checkpoints: Pass campus placement mock coding rounds in under 45 minutes
GitHub repository with clean README, CI test workflows, and live URL

yearly_milestones.label: Year 4 (Final Year)
goals: Convert campus placement opportunities or secure off-campus product offers
Study High-Level and Low-Level System Design fundamentals
Complete capstone final year project
projects: High-throughput URL shortener with rate-limiting and Redis cache
target_activities: Target Tier-1 & Tier-2 campus placement interviews
Network with alumni on LinkedIn for employee referrals
checkpoints: Secure acceptable full-time SDE offer prior to 8th semester
Maintain minimum 7.5 CGPA required for corporate shortlisting cutoffs

yearly_milestones.label: First 1-2 Years Post-Graduation
goals: Transition from Junior SDE to autonomous mid-level engineer
Own microservices in production with on-call monitoring
target_activities: Contribute to key open source projects
Lead technical design reviews inside engineering team
checkpoints: Promotion to SDE-2 or successful lateral transition with 30-50% increment

skill_gaps.why_it_matters: Primary elimination round in Indian on-campus technical assessments.
Demonstrates modern high-throughput API architecture over legacy synchronous code.
Interviewers scrutinize schema design, indexes, and ACID transaction boundaries.
Full-stack roles expect component lifecycle understanding and type safety.
Industry projects require reproducible local setups and containerized CI/CD builds.
Distinguishes strong candidates during round 2/3 technical interviews.
Required for day-one team readiness and pull request code reviews.

projects_to_build.title: Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor
projects_to_build.description: Multiplayer coding platform with WebSockets, syntax highlighting, and conflict resolution.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves concurrency handling, state synchronization, and socket lifecycle management.
projects_to_build.stretch_goal: Integrate isolated Docker sandbox for sandboxed code execution.

projects_to_build.title: Automated Campus Placement Portal
projects_to_build.description: Role-based recruiting platform for student eligibility checks, resume parsing, and interview scheduling.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves clean RESTful API design, JWT authentication, and relational data modeling.
projects_to_build.stretch_goal: Export ATS-friendly single-page PDF resumes with automated scoring.

projects_to_build.title: High-Throughput Distributed Rate Limiter
projects_to_build.description: Sliding-window rate limiting middleware with distributed Redis backing.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves deep systems thinking, benchmarking, and concurrency guarantees under load.

daily_tasks: Solve 2 LeetCode array/hashmap problems daily
Review Python type hints, async/await event loops, and generators
Set up clean GitHub repository structure for placement prep
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: 14 DSA problems solved and committed to GitHub with explanatory notes.

daily_tasks: Build 3-tier FastAPI service with Pydantic v2 validation
Configure SQLAlchemy 2.x declarative models and Alembic migrations
Implement JWT authentication with password hashing
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Fully functional, test-covered REST API with SQLite/PostgreSQL persistence.

daily_tasks: Scaffold React + Vite + TypeScript application
Connect frontend to backend API using TanStack Query
Handle loading, empty, and error states gracefully
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: End-to-end interactive web application communicating with local backend.

daily_tasks: Write unit and integration tests with Pytest and Vitest
Write multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml
Deploy backend to Render/Fly.io and frontend to Vercel
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Live public application with continuous integration and verified test suite.

resources.name: NeetCode DSA Roadmap
resources.description: Structured problem list categorized by data structure pattern.

resources.name: FastAPI Official Documentation
resources.description: Exemplary framework documentation covering async programming, dependency injection, and security.

resources.name: Full Stack Open (University of Helsinki)
resources.description: World-class open curriculum for modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React development.

risks_and_tradeoffs: Heavy saturation at the junior frontend level; deep backend and DSA depth is essential to stand out.
Balancing college internal semester exams with intensive LeetCode practice requires strict schedule discipline.

paths.title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer
paths.summary: Specializes in automation, continuous deployment pipelines, cloud platform architecture (AWS/GCP), container orchestration, and site reliability engineering.
paths.fit_reasoning: A solid grasp of Linux, networking, and scripting provides an excellent platform for cloud automation and DevOps roles.

india_market_notes.demand_outlook: Rapidly growing demand across Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India seeking cloud automation talent.

yearly_milestones.label: Year 3 (Pre-final Year)
goals: Master Linux administration, shell scripting, and computer networking
Gain proficiency in Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD
projects: Multi-stage CI/CD pipeline with automated vulnerability scanning
Nginx reverse proxy and SSL automation
target_activities: Earn AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate
Contribute to DevOps community open source tooling
checkpoints: Automated push-to-deploy workflow executing in GitHub Actions

yearly_milestones.label: Year 4 (Final Year)
goals: Learn Kubernetes container orchestration and Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code
Target cloud engineering campus and off-campus roles
projects: Production Kubernetes cluster deployment with Helm charts
target_activities: Apply to GCC graduate cloud programs and DevOps openings
checkpoints: Working Terraform configuration managing reproducible cloud infrastructure

yearly_milestones.label: First 1-2 Years Post-Graduation
goals: Achieve full production autonomy managing enterprise cloud estates
Implement Zero-Trust security and cost optimization policies
projects: Cloud cost reduction initiative saving 20% on monthly compute
checkpoints: Zero high-severity outages attributable to infrastructure configuration errors

skill_gaps.why_it_matters: Fundamental foundation for all servers, containers, and deployment targets.
Essential for packaging services and local simulation environments.
Frequently grilled in cloud troubleshooting and reliability interviews.
Core day-to-day responsibility for DevOps engineers.
Industry standard for automated cloud resource provisioning.
Differentiates entry-level candidates applying to top product firms.
Required to automate operational tasks and glue services together.

projects_to_build.title: Automated Multi-Environment GitOps Pipeline
projects_to_build.description: Continuous delivery pipeline using GitHub Actions, container scanning, and automated rollback.
projects_to_build.tech_stack: Docker, GitHub Actions, Trivy, Bash, AWS S3
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves understanding of secure supply chain security and deployment mechanics.

projects_to_build.title: Cloud Infrastructure Provisioner via Terraform
projects_to_build.description: Complete VPC, subnets, security groups, and auto-scaling EC2/ECS infrastructure managed through declarative code.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves mastery of IaC best practices, state management, and modularization.

projects_to_build.title: Observability Stack with Prometheus and Grafana
projects_to_build.description: Full monitoring setup collecting metrics, alerting on threshold breaches, and visualizing application health.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves operational mindset and telemetry diagnostics.

daily_tasks: Set up Ubuntu/Debian environment via WSL2 or virtual machine
Practice file permissions, process inspection (ps, top, systemctl), and log parsing (grep, awk, sed)
Write automated shell scripts for backup and health monitoring
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Completed Bandit levels 1-20 and authored 3 automated Linux administration scripts.

daily_tasks: Deep dive into CIDR notation, subnetting, DNS resolution, and TCP handshakes
Use tcpdump, curl, and dig to diagnose simulated network failures
Configure Nginx reverse proxy with virtual hosts
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Configured local Nginx reverse proxy routing multiple virtual hosts with custom headers.

daily_tasks: Containerize Python and Node.js sample applications
Optimize Docker layers for minimal image footprint
Orchestrate multi-container environments using docker-compose
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Multi-container web application stack running via docker-compose with volume persistence.

daily_tasks: Create GitHub Actions workflows triggered on push and pull requests
Automate linting, unit test execution, and image building
Push images to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR)
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Production CI pipeline with status badges and automated image publishing.

resources.name: Linux Journey
resources.description: Structured, free interactive introduction to Linux command line and systems.

resources.name: KodeKloud Community Challenges
resources.description: Hands-on free sandbox challenges covering Docker, Kubernetes, and Linux basics.

resources.name: AWS Skill Builder Free Tier
resources.description: Official foundational training provided by Amazon Web Services.

risks_and_tradeoffs: Fewer campus placement drives specifically hire freshers for pure DevOps compared to SDE; often requires entering via SDE/GET and moving internally.
Managing cloud accounts requires careful budgeting to avoid unexpected cloud provider charges on personal cards.

paths.title: Data Engineering & Pipeline Architect
paths.summary: Focuses on designing, building, and operating resilient data pipelines, distributed extract-transform-load (ETL) workflows, data warehousing, and analytics infrastructure.
paths.fit_reasoning: Background in Python and databases provides a gateway, though advanced SQL, distributed processing, and warehousing require focused preparation.

india_market_notes.demand_outlook: High growth as enterprise data volumes surge across Indian e-commerce, banking, and SaaS.

yearly_milestones.label: Year 3 (Pre-final Year)
goals: Attain mastery in complex SQL queries, window functions, and schema normalization
Learn Python data libraries (Pandas, Polars) and automated ETL scripting
projects: Automated ETL pipeline ingesting public Indian market APIs into PostgreSQL
Batch data warehouse modeling for sales intelligence
target_activities: Participate in analytics hackathons (Kaggle / Analytics Vidhya)
checkpoints: Comfortably write 50+ complex SQL queries involving CTEs and window functions

yearly_milestones.label: Year 4 (Final Year)
goals: Learn Apache Spark for distributed computation and orchestration with Apache Airflow
Target data engineering campus and off-campus interviews
projects: End-to-end Airflow DAG orchestrating daily data batch processing
target_activities: Target analytics consulting and FinTech data engineering campus interviews
checkpoints: Successful execution of multi-task DAG running on local Airflow instance

yearly_milestones.label: First 1-2 Years Post-Graduation
goals: Manage petabyte-scale data lakes and streaming architectures
Ensure data governance, schema evolution, and compliance
skills_to_learn: Data Lakehouse formats (Apache Iceberg / Delta Lake)
projects: Real-time event streaming pipeline processing 10,000 events/second
target_activities: Contribute to dbt or Airflow community plugins
checkpoints: Lead data reliability engineering initiatives and SLA enforcement

skill_gaps.why_it_matters: Primary testing mechanism for all data engineering interviews.
Essential for designing readable, performant analytical data warehouses.
Standard for custom data extraction and transformation logic.
Industry standard for scheduling, monitoring, and dependency management.
Required to handle datasets exceeding single-node memory capacity.
Most Indian enterprises have migrated analytical queries to the cloud.
Ensures pipeline data integrity before reaching business dashboards.

projects_to_build.title: Automated Indian Stock Market ETL Pipeline
projects_to_build.description: Daily batch pipeline scraping or consuming stock market feeds, cleaning data, and loading into an OLAP warehouse.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves understanding of scheduled batch jobs, idempotency, and error recovery.
projects_to_build.stretch_goal: Add anomaly detection alerts via Slack or Email webhook.

projects_to_build.title: Dimensional Data Warehouse for E-commerce
projects_to_build.description: Star-schema analytical database modeling customer orders, products, and fulfillment with optimized indexes.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves dimensional modeling and business intelligence presentation.

projects_to_build.title: Distributed PySpark Log Analyzer
projects_to_build.description: PySpark script processing large server access log datasets to detect traffic spikes and error clusters.
projects_to_build.what_it_proves: Proves distributed data transformations and memory management.

daily_tasks: Solve 3 medium LeetCode/Hackerrank SQL challenges daily
Master window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG, LEAD)
Design 3NF relational schemas for transactional workflows
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: 20 SQL challenge solutions and schema creation scripts stored in GitHub.

daily_tasks: Study Ralph Kimball dimensional modeling methodology
Design fact tables and dimension tables (SCD Type 1 & 2)
Implement analytical queries using Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
resources: PostgreSQL Official Documentation on Window Functions
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Complete dimensional star schema for an e-commerce platform with sample analytics queries.

daily_tasks: Build automated Python scripts to pull data from public REST APIs
Transform raw nested JSON into tabular structures using Pandas
Load cleaned records into PostgreSQL with upsert logic
resources: Real Python: Working with Databases in Python
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: End-to-end Python script performing daily API extraction, cleaning, and database loading.

daily_tasks: Package data ingestion scripts inside Docker containers
Spin up local Apache Airflow using Docker Compose
Write your first Python DAG with task dependencies and retries
weeks.end_of_week_outcome: Running local Airflow DAG executing daily data pipeline tasks with error alerts.

resources.name: Data Engineering Zoomcamp (DataTalks.Club)
resources.description: Comprehensive, highly regarded free open source course covering Docker, SQL, Airflow, Spark, and dbt.

resources.name: Mode Analytics SQL Tutorial
resources.description: Practical SQL tutorial focused on real-world business queries and window functions.

resources.name: PostgreSQL Official Documentation
resources.description: Authoritative guide for database indexes, execution plans (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), and concurrency.

risks_and_tradeoffs: Fewer off-campus fresher openings than general SDE roles; demands proven SQL and pipeline project proof to win interviews.
Requires learning distributed computing frameworks that are computationally heavy to run locally.

assumptions_made: Student can allocate 15-20 focused hours per week alongside regular college coursework and semester exams.
Student has personal laptop access with at least 8GB RAM and stable internet connectivity.
Student is aiming for on-campus campus placements starting in pre-final / final year and off-campus referrals.
disclaimers: All salary ranges, hiring trends, and company recommendations are market projections based on current Indian tech recruitment patterns and are NOT guarantees of employment.
Actual campus placement offers depend heavily on college tier, individual problem-solving speed under pressure, and company-specific hiring criteria.
Project timelines assume consistent weekly effort and self-directed study.
overall_recommendation: The Full Stack Developer pathway currently offers the strongest alignment (88 Fit Score) with the student's existing skill baseline, providing the widest availability of campus and off-campus fresher opportunities in India. Cloud/DevOps represents an excellent secondary specialization that can be merged with backend projects to create a standout portfolio.
